scientific.integrity: The primary publisher PDF was inspected at the model, disease-free statement, perturbation-parameter choice, and endemic resonance analysis. The earlier same-map stability paper was inspected for its disease-free multiplier and nonhyperbolicity conditions. A later broader SIR paper was inspected in full through its disease-free classification and endemic bifurcation sections. The bundled exact-arithmetic checker verifies the explicit witness; the family result is analytic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding concerns the reduced two-dimensional Euler map and a degenerate disease-free resonance. It does not claim a generic isolated strong-resonance normal form, does not alter the source's endemic-equilibrium calculations, and does not interpret the exact two-cycles as periodic solutions of the underlying continuous-time SIR system.

title: Exact disease-free two-cycle family at an omitted double-flip resonance in a discrete SIR map
